text.p: Unigene Laboratories Inc said on Wednesday that it completed a worldwide licensing agreement with Warner-Lambert Co that could lead to payments of $50 million for development of a osteoporosis treatment.

Unigene will get upfront and milestone payments of more than $50 million during development of oral calcitonin, sales royalties from the product and Warner-Lambert will also purchase an undisclosed amount of Unigene common stock.
The companies first announced the deal on June 30.
Warner-Lambert will develop and market the product and Unigene will exclusively supply the bulk calcitonin and provide analytical support services, Unigene said in a statement.
Calcitonin is a leading treatment for osteoporosis with annual worldwide sales of more than $700 million, but it is currently available only in injectable and nasal forms.
